mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, writer_id, content) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.writer_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS writerNickname, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c JOIN members m ON m.member_id = c.writer_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
